title: Large Kids Play Tent W Flags Star Lights Portable Teepee In Outdoor Dome Tent
body_html:
Features:
- It can accommodate multiple children, providing ample space for playing, learning and resting.
- With its unique dome-shaped castle design, similar to the cabins in fairy tales, it creates an imaginative private space for the children. The dome structure not only enhances the interior spaciousness but also improves the overall stability, preventing the tent from easily tipping over.
- The assembly process is very simple, requiring only two steps and no tools. Even older children can easily participate in the gathering with the help of their parents.
- Made of polyester fiber fabric, it has a soft touch.
- Suitable for boys and girls, it blends perfectly with any room decoration style.



Specifications:
Colour: Beige
Size: 130x130x100cm
Material: Polyester



Package Included:

1x Play Tent
1x Light String
1x String of Colorful Flags
